title: Medu Vada
description: Deep-fried, crisp-on-the-outside and fluffy-inside urad dal fritters, shaped into rings — a beloved South Indian snack, often served with sambar and chutney.
steps: Soak the urad dal in water for 3-4 hours, then drain thoroughly.
Grind the soaked dal with very little water into a thick, smooth, fluffy batter — it should hold its shape and not be runny. Whip the batter with your hand for a minute to incorporate air.
Fold in the salt, green chillies, ginger, curry leaves, crushed pepper and onion if using.
Heat oil in a deep pan to medium-hot. Wet your palm, take a small ball of batter, flatten it slightly and poke a hole in the centre with your thumb to form a ring.
Gently slide the vada into the hot oil. Fry in batches, turning occasionally, for 4-5 minutes until deep golden brown and crisp on the outside.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar.
